source.quote: For the full year, we continue to forecast international net sales up approximately 20% on top of strong results last year.
We now expect net sales to be in the range of $7.1 billion to $7.18 billion, up from our prior range of $7.03 billion to $7.13 billion and compared to net sales of $6.55 billion in fiscal year 25.
We now expect fiscal 26 adjusted operating income in the range of $560 million to $590 million compared to $403 million in fiscal 25.
We are forecasting third quarter net sales in the range of $1.57 billion to $1.6 billion compared to net sales of $1.47 billion in the third quarter of 25.
This outlook assumes top line growth of approximately 7% to 9% based on continued momentum quarter to date in our North American business as well as strength in our international business.

With this sales outlook, we expect third quarter 26 operating income to be in the range of $10 million to $20 million compared to adjusted operating income of approximately breakeven in the third quarter of 25.
Expect our third quarter 2026 gross margin rate to be about 38% compared to 36.5% in the third quarter of 25 representing approximately 150 basis points of expansion.
Net sales increased 10% year over year, near the high end of our guidance.
And our adjusted net income per diluted share was $0.95 above the high end of our guidance range of $0.65 to $0.75 and compared to $0.33 in the second quarter of last year.
